resources.string: Pick a computer to use its gh sign-in; device code sign-in doesn\'t depend on any computer. Switching signs out of the previous one.
Checking gh sign-in on your computers…
No computer needed: enter a code on GitHub to authorize
Device-code authorization is stored encrypted on the hub; it\'s forgotten when you switch to gh on a computer.
personad is too old to read gh sign-in
Device code sign-in is missing the %1$s scope: switch to another sign-in method, then sign in with a device code again.
gh on %1$s is missing the %2$s scope: run gh auth refresh -s %3$s on that computer, or use device code sign-in.
CI failures don\'t go to the Inbox.
Only CI failures on the default branch go to the Inbox, as Needs you.
CI failures on every branch count as Needs you.
CI failures on the default branch and your open PRs count as Needs you; other branches are FYI.

" Failures on the same branch are grouped into one item, reruns included; it's marked done automatically once a run passes, the branch is deleted, or the PR is merged. Automated branches (%1$s) aren't flagged."
" @mentions, review requests, and requested changes from people count as Needs you; ones from bots are FYI. Muted repositories send nothing to the Inbox, and existing items are marked done."
